cairn-capability.{py,sh} installs then verifies (capability list reports cairn active + the staged bundle carries its gate scripts); /cairn:init branches on the exit code instead of swallowing it; CI runs gsd-core's validateCapability against a pinned checkout and fails on a skip.

cairn-doctor gained the gsd-capability check: names the installed GSD lineage and whether the capability registered. Fails (not warns) on a legacy lineage, an unregistered capability, or a bundle staged without its gate script; warns only when no GSD binary is discoverable. CAIRN_GSD_BIN pins discovery so the verdict is reproducible across machines.

Deprecated gsd marketplace entry kept alongside gsd-core with its consequence and removal version (v1.4) in its own description; cairn/docs/gsd-core-migration.md documents the path, which leaves .planning/ and .beads/ untouched.

cairn/docs/gsd-core-commands.md records an explicit decision for all 54 unreferenced gsd-core commands: 13 wrapped, 39 use-directly, 2 out of scope, each with a stated reason tied to a written criterion. Counts derived from gsd-core@v1.8.0 (the research note's 24 was an undercount); coverage verified by script. The 13 wrappers are filed as CairnGo-9xy.

phase_model() reads title, plan progress, requirements, milestone, disk state, dependencies and the next legal command; the terminal board, --json and the HTML page all render from that one read, proven by a cross-surface test. roadmap_phases() is now a derivation of it, so the counts cannot drift from the described list.

Pending phases render as a described list — number, title, requirement ids, state on disk, plan progress and what they wait on. Completed phases drop out. An operator can pick the next phase without opening ROADMAP.md.

Next /cairn:* commands are computed from each phase's own state on disk and ordered by the dependency graph (free work first), each carrying the reason it sits where it does. A finished milestone gets /cairn:ship then /cairn:milestone complete.

parallelism() names the phases nothing open blocks and describes the split in real commands ('alongside', never 'then'). An undeclared graph is reported as such instead of as universal independence. /cairn:autonomous now resolves and announces its order from the model.

The HTML board carries the pending list, the next commands and the parallelism note, and the grid grows to 1440px on a desktop instead of sitting in a fixed 1024px column. Verified by measurement at 1728/1280/680: symmetric gutters, no horizontal scroll, prose held at ~55ch.
